content: He who has attained Self-knowledge is unaffected by pleasure or pain, just as the sky remains unstained by clouds drifting across it.
author: Adi Shankara
explanation: Pleasure and pain arise in the psycho-physical organism, but the true Self is the unattached witness, perpetually serene and unconditioned.
practicalInsight: When an unpleasant emotion arises today, imagine yourself as the boundless open sky allowing the gray cloud to drift through without resisting or grasping.
reflectionPrompt: Can I let this emotional weather pass through without defining my core peace by it?
